## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与改动后行为

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] Publication audit / 上传审计
- [ ] Unit tests, or explain why they are not applicable / 单元测试，或说明不适用原因
- [ ] Hardware testing scope stated, if any / 如涉及实机测试，已说明范围
- [ ] Chinese / English docs checked / 已检查中英文文档
- [ ] No device logs, secrets or personal signing settings / 无设备日志、凭据或个人签名配置
